_about: CodeQL alerts on hrr-playback that have been reviewed. Read by codeql_gate.py (its docstring says what each field means), which .github/workflows/hrr-replay-codeql.yml runs. Reviewed with CodeQL 2.27.2, cpp-security-extended, on develop 839470366c; the sources, each named by caption, file and line text, were taken from a run at 4c2e036fcb on develop 25c7cab4d1.

alerts.reason: read_process_manifest reads a process manifest under the archive directory named on the command line. The person running hrr-playback chooses that path and can already read whatever it names; no trust boundary is crossed.
Opens manifest.json under the archive directory named on the command line: the same user-chosen path, joined with a fixed name.
open_record_stream opens a stream file (events.bin and the like) under the archive directory named on the command line. The directory is the user's choice and the file names are fixed.

read_file_capped opens a blob or code object under the archive directory named on the command line, in a file named after a hash from an archive record, whose header and payload read_raw_record reads with the two freads listed. The record's bytes reach the path only through hrr::hash_hex, which prints two uint64 values as exactly 32 hex digits, so a record cannot put a separator or '..' into the path. On 1 October this alert was reported at hip_playback.cpp:189.
